title: UCP capability namespace tree
caption: Names follow reverse domain, service, capability. Everything under dev.ucp belongs to the UCP governing body and carries the release date as its version; vendors use their own reverse domain and version independently. Payment extensions moved from shopping to common.payment in v2026-08-25. Ask was backported into the 2026-08-25 release branch on 2026-11-02 and is not in the v2026-08-25 git tag. Items marked draft exist only on main (as of 2026-11-14).
alt: Tree. dev.ucp has four services: shopping, common, and the drafts lodging and food. Shopping has checkout, cart, catalog.search, catalog.lookup, order and permalink; checkout is extended by fulfillment, discount and buyer_consent. Common has identity_linking, location.search and location.lookup, loyalty as an extension, payment, and ask, which the 2026-08-25 release branch gained on 2026-11-02. Payment has ap2_mandate (formerly shopping.ap2_mandate), authentication for 3DS2 actions, split_payments and terms. Lodging has a draft booking capability. Food has a draft checkout capability extended by draft fulfillment and tip extensions. Separately, com.vendor and org.org namespaces version independently.
